# Apogee

> Private, In-Browser AI Summarizer for articles, videos, and PDFs. Runs on WebGPU, WebAssembly, or Local Ollama with zero cloud dependencies or tracking.

Apogee is an offline-first browser extension for Chromium (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Arc) and Firefox. It summarizes web pages, YouTube and Bilibili videos, and PDFs on-device. It also supports interactive Q&A (Ask) and sentence highlighting.

## Core Capabilities

- **In-Browser Execution**:
  - WebGPU (WebLLM): Default on Chromium (Qwen 2.5 1.5B, SmolLM2 1.7B, Llama 3.2 1B, Phi 3.5 Mini).
  - WebAssembly on CPU (Transformers.js): Default on Firefox, opt-in on Chromium (SmolLM2 360M, Qwen 2.5 0.5B).
- **Local Ollama Mode**: Connects directly to http://127.0.0.1:11434 over local loopback. Uses declarativeNetRequest to bypass CORS.
- **On-Device Retrieval and Grounding**: Uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings for passage retrieval (Ask) and sentence highlighting.
- **Privacy Guarantee**: Page content, questions, and summaries do not leave the machine.

## Codebase Architecture

The project is structured under the apogee-extension directory:

```
apogee/
├── apogee-extension/         # Main extension directory
│   ├── background/           # Service worker and message routing
│   │   └── service-worker.js
│   ├── popup/                # Popup UI (HTML, CSS, JS)
│   ├── lib/                  # Core libraries
│   │   ├── extract/          # Page text and video extractors
│   │   └── llm/              # Engine interfaces (WebLLM, Transformers.js, Ollama)
│   ├── offscreen/            # Offscreen document for WebGPU and WASM execution
│   ├── tests/                # Node test harness and fixtures
│   │   └── extractors/       # Extractor unit tests
│   └── manifest.json         # Extension manifest (MV3)
├── README.md                 # Project overview and user guide
├── CONTRIBUTING.md           # Developer setup and contribution guide
└── ROADMAP.md                # Planned features and project direction
```

## Quick Instructions for AI Agents

- **Node Version**: Node.js 22 or newer (.nvmrc pins 22).
- **Commands** (run in root or inside apogee-extension):
  - `npm install`: Install dependencies.
  - `npm run dev`: Watch mode. Rebuilds dist/chrome and dist/firefox on changes.
  - `npm run build`: Build both dist/chrome and dist/firefox packages.
  - `npm test`: Run Node test suite (node --test).
  - `npm run lint`: Run ESLint check.
  - `npm run format:check`: Check formatting with Prettier.

## Writing Site Extractors

Extractors read active tab HTML and return clean text or timestamped transcripts.
- Extractor tests run in plain Node against HTML fixtures without a browser or GPU.
- Sample extractors: apogee-extension/lib/extract/
- Test fixtures: apogee-extension/tests/extractors/fixtures/

## Key Documentation

- README.md: Architecture diagrams, screenshots, privacy policy breakdown, and browser support matrix.
- CONTRIBUTING.md: Development setup, PR rules, test commands, and issue claiming rules.
- ROADMAP.md: Project goals and feature roadmap.
- PRIVACY.md: Published privacy policy.
